title: Early Settlement Relief on No-Show Charges — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Relief schedule, Specimen Collection Appointments — missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit.** The settlement of a no-show charge carries an early settlement relief set by the days elapsed for the missed visit (calendar days counted up to today) and by the patient's test invoices in Patient Invoices & Statements — whether any of them is with the collection agency (an invoice in collections status).

**Clause.** When the days elapsed for the missed visit are 7 or fewer and none of the patient's test invoices is with the collection agency, the relief is 10 percent; when they are 8 to 30 and none of the patient's test invoices is with the collection agency, it is 4 percent; otherwise there is no early settlement relief.

| Days elapsed | An invoice of the patient with the collection agency | Early settlement relief |
|---|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | No | 10 percent |
| 8 to 30 | No | 4 percent |
| More than 30 | No | None |
| Any | Yes | None |

**Edges (hypothetical, no invoice in collections).** 7 days: 10 percent. 8 days: 4 percent. 30 days: 4 percent. 31 days: none.
